label: TP-Link Archer MR600
description: AC1200 4G LTE router: one gigabit LAN/WAN port, three gigabit LAN ports, a nano SIM slot and dual-band Wi-Fi 5.
notes: Vendor figures from the TP-Link datasheet: 1x 10/100/1000 Mbps LAN/WAN port, 3x 10/100/1000 Mbps LAN ports and 1x nano SIM card slot; 802.11a/n/ac on 5 GHz and 802.11b/g/n on 2.4 GHz at 300 Mbps and 867 Mbps respectively. The LTE category was not captured during intake - the SIM slot and the 4G class are confirmed, but the modem is modelled at the conservative 100M Cat 4 class rather than guessing Cat 6. If your unit is Cat 6, say so and the interface rate gets corrected.
